name: PEAK: Escape from Hell
detailed_description:
PEAK: Escape from Hell

Four friends thought it was just an ordinary night drive. But after a devastating crash, they awoke in the pits of hell itself. The only way out is to climb—higher and higher—through seven deadly layers of this cursed realm.

Each level in PEAK is filled with unique horrors, brutal traps, and hidden secrets. Sometimes you’ll fight to ascend alone. Other times, you’ll depend on your teammates to survive. Without balance, courage, and the will to move as one, reaching the summit is impossible.

Among the screams echoing off hell’s walls, you must hold onto hope. If you fall, you start over. Giving up is easy. Climbing to the peak is only for the most stubborn souls.

Key Features:

  • 4-player co-op climbing: Test your teamwork against hell itself.

  • Immersive physics-based mechanics: Every step is a risk—and a reward.

  • Horror meets action: Feel the oppressive atmosphere in your bones.

  • Seven unique hellscapes: Discover hidden paths and new challenges in each layer.

  • Replayable and relentless: Fail, learn, and try again until you escape.

The peak is calling. Will you rise?
